verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents its own accounting sync: "One-click sync with NetSuite, QuickBooks, and Xero," with transactions exported with reference ID, timestamp, and on-chain hash. This is a first-party ERP integration that reduces manual entry, but the claim is a brief marketing line on the Instant Pay page and says nothing about sync direction or timing. Missing for 10: evidence that the sync is real-time rather than one-click or manual, evidence that it is bidirectional (ERP back to Jeeves), coverage of cards and expenses beyond Instant Pay transactions, detailed integration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can rely on real-time bidirectional sync with my ERP instead of manual journal entries
